query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tokenBalance = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zero_balance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tokenBalance > 0 AND tokenBalance <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as low_balance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tokenBalance > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as good_balance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN isBlocked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as blocked,
  MIN(tokenBalance) as min_balance,
  MAX(tokenBalance) as max_balance,
  AVG(tokenBalance) as avg_balance
FROM app_users;
